scoring_rubric.pass_threshold: >=4/5 dims pass (majority vote of 3 independent reads per dim)

dim1.label: structural_form
dim1.description: Single-storey WikiHouse structural body visible. Rectangular wall zone from ground to eave (~2400mm). Gable-end wall above eave to ridge (~4561mm total). No mid-floor band (single storey).
dim1.pass_criteria: Single-storey reading — no floor band; wall zone + triangular gable top; eave line at ~2400mm height

dim2.label: roof_pitch_steep
dim2.description: 42° gable pitch — noticeably STEEPER than Villa Verde (24°). Gable triangle appears taller-than-wide in the roof zone alone (rise=2161mm > half-width=2718mm... wait, half-span=2400mm. Rise=2161mm < half-span=2400mm so slope is <1:1). Pitch appears moderately steep.
dim2.pass_criteria: Triangular gable peak clearly visible; pitch appears distinctly steeper than a shallow domestic gable (~20-25°); roof zone occupies roughly half the total facade height

dim3.label: fenestration_symmetric
dim3.description: 3 openings on front face: 1 door (centered, x=2718mm) flanked by 2 identical windows (S=1200mm each). Symmetric layout. No upper floor openings (single storey).
dim3.pass_criteria: 3 openings visible; centered door flanked by symmetric windows; clean wall panels at edges; single-storey (no UF openings)

dim4.label: massing_landscape
dim4.description: Front facade is LANDSCAPE orientation — width (5436mm) > height (4561mm), ratio ~1.19:1. Single storey + steep 42° roof keeps total height lower than width. Contrast with Villa Verde near-square (6096×6245mm).
dim4.pass_criteria: Building reads wider than it is tall — landscape aspect ratio ~1.2:1; clearly single-storey character

dim5.label: structural_cladding
dim5.description: WikiHouse timber frame visible or implied. Light-colored structural wall (cream/white render or timber cladding). Gray or darker roof. Clean utilitarian form.
dim5.pass_criteria: Light-colored wall zone with distinct roof zone; simple utilitarian appearance appropriate for prefab timber structure
